source: EPA NVFEL benchmark test-data package, workbook '4- 2016 Honda 1.5L L15B7 Engine Tier 2 Fuel - Test Data.xlsx' (package directory 2016-honda-1-5l-l15b7-engine-tier-2-fuel-test-data-package-02-04-19); public data, https://www.epa.gov/vehicle-and-fuel-emissions-testing/ (urls in out/epa_turbo_dl/urls.txt). Literal workbook readings rounded to 6 significant digits; nothing derived except the normalised cam signs, the two-bank lambda mean and the envelope / high_load flags.
selection: high_load = bmep_bar >= 0.5 * max(bmep_bar) = 9.9703 bar; envelope = highest torque among all rows of the 50-rpm speed bin

cam_convention.normalised: intake_cam_adv_deg positive = advanced; exhaust_cam_ret_deg positive = retarded
